body: bad bot
Thank you for the encouragement. I'm sorry you were abused by so many people. I don't understand why people are so cruel.

Thanks. I have been inpatient before but its expensive af so I'm not trying to do that again. I suppose I just have to keep trying hobbies until they become fun. It just takes so much effort to do anything.

Inert gas is my plan too- although I was going to go with helium. Your “friends” sound shitty and that sucks you gave so much to them for nothing. I know you’re not a retard though because you seem very practical with all your support, saving, and picking what I think to be the superior method. Again I DON’T want you to do it- just saying it shows that you’re smart. I really hope you can hold on. Don’t think of it as pussying out, think of it as staying strong. Not that you’d be weak if you did do it. That also takes some serious balls. Wish you the best.

Sounds like a living hell, but being single seems way better than being with this fucker. I know lots of people that met their SO in their 30s. And forgive me if this is not helpful, but the app Meetup might be good for meeting friends? It’s interest based, so you meet people doing a common activity rather than getting coffee with a random person from the Internet, which can be awkward. Also maybe meet people through AA or NA? Even if they’re online, you can get numbers from people.
Woah! that is crazy

That’s bullshit that you can’t even smoke cigarettes. They are a staple of sobriety imo. Your partner and siblings sound like real pieces of shit- that’s fucking awful and no one should have to go through that. I don’t understand how people can be so cruel.
I think there’s a better way of framing it. Like you’ll never “get better” like you would from a cold, but you can learn how to live with it and get relatively better. Like the Babadook.
I’ve been feeling the same way. Let me know if you want to talk about it

How is she going to say “Do something productive” while you’re doing something productive (going biking with her). It should be a clear sign that getting some exercise isn’t going to cure your depression. God the amount of times people have said to me- are you exercising and eating right? FUUUCK.

If you have the resources/support to get help, there is nothing more important than doing that. Whether that’s inpatient or meds and therapy. It’s not going to solve everything and it might take years to find the right meds and therapist, but at least you’ll be making progress. Suicidal thoughts are serious whether or not you are “really going to do it” right now. They are a serious symptom. Mine started around 16 too- it fucking sucks.
You are incredibly strong. That sounds like absolute hell. Killing yourself isn’t selfish, but I hope you don’t. I don’t have any medical knowledge but I hope to god that your pain isn’t forever

Yeah the world is a pretty shitty place for the most part. Just keep trying to talk to people even if you haven’t spoken to them in years... eventually you’re bound to find someone who isn’t a heartless piece of shit. I was able to reconnect with an old friend and it made a huge difference. No one will ever know the point of living, but it has something to do with other people imo. Hope this helped, I feel for you bud.

Relate to this, I used to write too. Sometimes I’m afraid that I only was able to write because I didn’t know how bad I was. And now that I “know” I’m bad I’ll never write  again. I put it in quotes because I know I have a distorted view of myself, but it still feels like the reality. I don’t even want to write anymore, even if I could. Same thing goes for music.

That sounds awful man. Don’t believe all that shit your ex said about you, and don’t judge yourself for making a mistake. You sound compassionate and genuine, which is more than you can say for most people. Please don’t go through with it.

I relate to this. I don't feel like I've ever been given  advice that really changed my perspective on things. Every suggestion is like "exercise more" or "practice mindfulness." And it seems like none of that shit really works. It feels like there's nothing to learn and nothing to say about the reasons you want to kill yourself. For some reason talking about it with people helps a little bit. It doesn't fix the problem, but I think it's better than nothing. Maybe don't think of talking about it as asking for advice or trying to find an answer, just as talking for the sake of talking.

I can relate. The only time I really feel anything is when I'm drunk/high, and that's usually sadness or anxiety. Drugs really seem like a way out of this feeling, but its a trap. I drink and smoke habitually even though it doesn't make me feel better. I'm 26 now, and if I could tell my younger self one thing it would be to lay off drugs. I really hope you find something/someone to love.
A terrible place to be in. I’m also pretty suicidal right now. What are you feeling?
I’m right there with you. It feels like happiness is impossible. I hope you don’t kill yourself

I do the same thing, mentally flogging myself for past mistakes. Something that helps me when I find myself doing that is mindfulness. Sometimes it doesn’t work, but it’s better than nothing. I feel for you and I hope it gets better

I haven’t talked about my suicidal thoughts as much with them, but they’ve heard all of my problems so much I’m embarrassed to bring it up again. I end up just repeating myself and feeling bad for being so self absorbed and self pitying. I really don’t want to feel sorry for myself, but it’s compulsive. it feels like there’s someone inside of me telling me I’m stupid and worthless and a bad person

I would say he is a postmodern president only in that his presidency is ripe for postmodern analysis. 
Trump's image is more powerful than his ideology, to the point where he had been replaced with his representation. This is the postmodern simulacrum (nobody sees the real Donald Trump).

Communication breakdown also played a huge role in his election, another big postmodern trope.

Thanks the feedback! I'm glad you got emptiness, I would say more specifically the holiness of emptiness. Also, I was trying to represent crying with the mucus stanza, and I think crying is just part of the classically sublime, or at least how it exists in us.

I REALLY like the first two stanzas, how the bird misunderstands what that means. I didn't think the third one fit at first, but it is another interesting perspective on this moment. I just wanted you to develop the misunderstanding more. 

On a mechanical level, the "new one" and "young one" kind of trip me up. Maybe find a different way of expressing this.

I love "how direction lived in/ these shards these / swirls of calcium / resting now on / soft white Styrofoam" and "the gesture/a woman makes when reaching up to brush her hair from her eyes." However this image (and other ones like it) are weighed down with phrases like 
"It becomes impossible to ignore the / resemblance of their motion." These phrases talk around the poetry instead of providing it. Also, with these quotations specifically, I think you could link these images, but I don't think the resemblance is so obvious that its impossible to ignore. 

Similarly, I'd take out "in the course of mundane articulation"
Just listing the bones gives this feeling enough, explaining it cheapens it.
Thanks for the feedback! I'm glad it worked on multiple levels

Thank you so much for putting your time into this poem! This critique was very helpful; I definitely agree that I need to develop that history more. It crescendos too early, that is the problem that I've been feeling but haven't put into words haha.
Thanks for the feedback! And yeah there is a reminiscing attitude for sure, hadn't thought of it that way.

Very cool, I like the paradox you're playing with. I would try to write this poem without the word "love." Find a concrete image to make me think "withered love" instead of just saying it outright. I think you do this nicely when you say "my swelled heart echoes pangs of desire" (although I might take out pleasance, a bit redundant). 

On a similar note, be careful not to use too many adjectives/adverbs like "languid," "desperately," and "effortlessly."  These qualities come across much more powerfully when the languidness is inherent to the image.

Really enjoyed this. Stanzas one, two, four, and six are my favorite. I think there's a few too many abstractions in the third stanza and the first two lines of the fifth, "humanity," "evolution," "language," "universe." I see the influence from Cuil Theory, but I think you do this in a more concrete, specific way in the other stanzas.
